Slow down. Breathe in the country.
An award-winning, modern spa with accommodation, tucked into the rural village of Bozeat. Join us for a day spa, an overnight spa break, or take the whole house for the weekend.
Explore the spa
Welcome to York Cottage
A cottage, a spa pool and nowhere you need to be.
Warm water, a hot sauna, soft robes and something good to eat. York Cottage is a small, modern spa in a village setting, built for unhurried days and quiet nights away.
Come for a morning or afternoon session, stay the night in an ensuite room, or gather friends and family and have the house and spa entirely to yourselves.
Loved by our guests
Hundreds of guests have shared their days, nights and weekends at York Cottage. Read what they say, then come and see for yourself.

Good to know
Before you arrive
A few things guests often ask. For anything else, ask our assistant for an instant answer, or call 01933 580 100.
Email the team
What's included in a day spa?
A 20-minute aromatherapy massage or facial, hot and cold refreshments, afternoon tea or a grazing board, and full use of the spa pool, sauna and lounge. Towels and robes are provided.
Can I change my booking?
Spa days are non-refundable, but can be rescheduled (subject to availability) if you email us at least 30 days before your visit. Spa breaks can be refunded with at least 30 days' notice.
Is there an age limit?
Guests must be 18 or over to book. Under-16s can use the spa only during a Private Spa session or a whole-house booking, and under-18s can't join spa breaks.
What are the session and check-in times?

Day Spa sessions run 09:30–13:30 or 13:00–17:00. Spa Access sessions start at 09:30 or 14:00, with evening sessions too. On spa breaks, check-in is from 13:30 with the spa 14:00–18:00 (Monday to Thursday), or from 14:00 with the spa 18:00–22:30 on Sundays. Whole-house stays check in from 16:00. Check-out is 11:00.
How much is the whole house?
From £1,840 per night for exclusive use of the house and spa, for up to 16 guests, with a 2-night minimum. Rates can vary by date.
Can I bring my dog?
We love them, but we can only welcome working animals at York Cottage.
How do gift vouchers work?
Vouchers are non-refundable and have no cash value. Please bring yours with you on arrival.

Can 16 and 17-year-olds come?

FAQs
Good to know
Answers to the questions guests ask most. Can’t find yours? Ask our assistant for an instant answer.
Day Spa
Can I book more treatments as well as those included?
Yes. Add them when you book, or see the treatment menu. We recommend booking extra treatments ahead of your visit.
Can we bring our own food and drink?
Yes, you’re welcome to bring snacks and drinks. We’re happy to supply bowls, cutlery and glassware.
How many people will be in the spa with us?
On Day Spa sessions we aim for a maximum of 6 people. Capacity is 12, but we limit shared sessions so you have plenty of space and privacy.
Can we have our afternoon tea or grazing board before or after the spa?
Yes, we recommend it to make the most of your spa time. Let us know if you’d like to arrive early, and you’re welcome to enjoy the gardens and lounges afterwards.
Are children allowed in the spa?
16 to 18-year-olds are welcome on all Day Spa sessions. Under-16s can join Private Spa sessions only. Under-18s must be with an adult at all times.
Can you cater for nut allergies or food intolerances?
Yes. Tell us when you book and we’ll take care of it.
Can we have a vegan or veggie afternoon tea or grazing board?
Yes, we cater for all dietary requirements. You’ll be asked when you book.
Do you have a Blue Light discount?
Blue Light Card holders get their included treatments upgraded to 30 minutes.
Overnight Spa Breaks
What time is check-in and check-out?
Check-in is from 13:30 Monday to Thursday. On Sundays, check-in times are shown when you book. Check-out is 11:00, and you’re welcome to enjoy the house and gardens afterwards.
What time will our spa access be?
It depends on the slot you book. Typically 14:00–18:00, or the evening slot on Sundays. Your treatments take place during your spa time.
What’s available for breakfast?
Continental breakfast (£10 per person) needs to be pre-ordered. Add it when you book.
Can we order a takeaway?
Yes. Indian, Chinese, Italian and Turkish takeaways deliver to us; menus are in the house guide.
Are there restaurants nearby?
Yes, a short drive away, from fine dining to pub food. See our local recommendations.
Are there cooking facilities?
Yes, a communal guest kitchen with an oven and cooking equipment.
Can we hire a private chef?
Yes. Get in touch and we’ll put you in touch with a recommended chef.
Can you store our luggage?
Yes, before or after check-in.
General
Is there free parking?
Yes, plenty.
Is there Wi-Fi?
Yes, free throughout the property.
Are treatments safe during pregnancy?
Yes. Our therapists are trained in pregnancy massage. Tell us you’re pregnant at your consultation.
Do you have an electric car charger?
We have one charger, first come first served.
Can I get a VAT receipt?
Yes. Send us a message and we’ll arrange it.
Can I bring my dog?
Pets aren’t allowed, but working animals are welcome.
Whole House
Do we have the spa to ourselves?
Yes. We won’t book any other guests into the spa during your stay. On check-out day the spa is available until 10:30 so it can be cleaned for the next guests.
How does the damage deposit work?
You’ll get a payment link within 48 hours of check-in to pre-authorise £500. After our property check, it’s released within 48 hours of check-out, minus any deductions.
Can we book for 1 night?
There’s a 2-night minimum on Fridays and Saturdays. Midweek stays may be possible; please contact us.
Do you include firewood and charcoal?
We include one basket of firewood for the open fire and fire pit. A garage 3 miles away sells more, plus charcoal for the BBQ.
Gift Vouchers
How do I redeem my gift voucher?
Enter the code on your voucher in the gift voucher box when you pay, and bring the voucher with you.
Do gift vouchers expire?
Yes, they must be used within 12 months of issue.
Still have a question?
Our assistant answers instantly, day or night. For anything it can’t help with, email the team.

Privacy Policy
Your privacy
How we look after your information.
Introduction
This policy explains how York Cottage Spa collects and uses personal information through this website.
What we collect

Information you give us when you sign up to our newsletter, create an account or buy spa sessions, gift vouchers or other services. This can include your name and contact details, age, gender and country, login details, why you’re visiting and your interests, medical information needed to give treatments safely, and details of guests visiting with you. We also collect information about how you use the site through cookies.
How we use it

To provide the information, prices, products and services you ask for, process bookings and payments, and run offers. To keep you informed about your booking. With your consent, to send marketing about products similar to those you’ve bought, measure our advertising and make recommendations.
Sharing

We never sell or rent your data, or share it for others’ marketing. Service providers who help us (for example with bookings or emails) only receive what they need and must keep it secure. Your data isn’t transferred or stored outside the European Economic Area.
Your choices
We won’t email, call or text you without your consent. You can unsubscribe using the link in any email or update your preferences in your account.
Cookies
Necessary cookies make the site work. Statistical cookies help us understand how the site is used. Marketing cookies measure and target advertising.
Your rights
You can exercise your rights under the GDPR. Reasonable requests are free and handled within the time allowed; repeated requests may carry a fee, which we’ll tell you about first.

Terms & Conditions
Booking terms
Please read these before you book.
About these terms

A contract with York Cottage Spa Ltd begins when we receive payment and send a booking confirmation showing your dates. It applies to you and everyone in your party, so please make sure they accept these terms and the documents they include. Not sharing relevant information, or not following these terms, may mean your booking is cancelled.
1. Day Spa and Spa Breaks

Reservations. All online Day Spa and Spa Break bookings are paid in full. There’s no refund for leaving early unless caused by significant negligence by us or our staff. Promotional rates can’t be combined with other offers. Included treatments are 20 minutes unless stated otherwise.
Spa day cancellation. Spa days are non-refundable. You can reschedule, subject to availability, by emailing us at least 30 days before your visit.
Spa break cancellation. Overnight spa breaks are refundable with at least 30 days’ notice. With less notice, a 100% cancellation fee applies.
2. Whole House bookings
Payment. 50% is due when you book and the balance 6 weeks before your stay. Bookings made within 6 weeks are paid in full.

Cancellation. With 6 months’ notice or more, your dates can be moved to another available date. With 6 weeks’ notice or more, the deposit is kept as a cancellation fee. With less than 6 weeks’ notice, the full payment is kept. Leaving early incurs the full cost of the remaining nights. We strongly recommend travel insurance.
Occupancy and age. No parties or events. A maximum of 16 people may use the accommodation at any time. We can’t accept bookings from anyone under 18, and we may refuse any booking.
Check-in and check-out. Stays normally start at 16:00 unless agreed otherwise. Please leave by 11:00 on departure day; cleaners may arrive from 09:00.

Damage deposit. A £500 card pre-authorisation is needed before check-in. We send a payment link 48 hours before arrival, check the property at check-out, and report any damage within 48 hours. You’re responsible for any loss or damage caused by your party.

House rules. No pets (working animals excepted), smoking or vaping indoors, or candles in the house; any of these ends the booking without refund. Don’t move furniture between rooms, keep noise low between 22:00 and 07:00, use designated parking, and lock up when you go out. The spa pool is available 08:00 to 22:00; please shower first and keep glass away from the pool. Use the BBQ only on hard ground. Children must be supervised at all times. Please report any problem while you’re still with us; complaints made after leaving can’t be considered.
Other. We may enter for essential maintenance or inspection. We aren’t liable for temporary equipment faults or utility outages, or for lost belongings. The property may not be sublet.
3. General conditions
Gift vouchers. Please bring your voucher with you. Vouchers used to pay are void if you don’t arrive. They are non-refundable, have no cash value and must be used within 12 months.
Breakdowns. We’ll fix mechanical or electrical faults as quickly as we can. Refunds are only given if a fault is due to our negligence.
Valuables. We can’t accept responsibility for money or valuables, so please insure them yourself.

Children and pets. Pets aren’t allowed, except working animals. Under-18s must be supervised by an adult at all times, especially around the spa pool. Under-16s may use the spa only during a Private Spa session or a whole-house booking. Under-18s aren’t permitted on spa breaks.
